scope: Eight non-representative S4 ecology references for recently added Paleozoic and Cenozoic taxa.
copyrightSafety: OpenAI built-in image generation was used for original project assets. Sources constrained factual anatomy and broad habitat only; no external artwork, composition, named artist style, logo, text or franchise material was copied.

opabinia-regalis-s4.promptSummary: Low front-three-quarter Burgess shelf swim; exactly five clustered eyes and one bristled proboscis.

tiktaalik-roseae-s4.promptSummary: Waterline rear-three-quarter shallow-channel scene; no digits or terrestrial walking claim.

arthropleura-armata-s4.promptSummary: Post-rain Carboniferous lycopsid-bark crossing with unbranched tergites and dense leg rows.

meganeura-monyi-s4.promptSummary: Low underside coal-swamp glide with four thoracic wings and six legs.

titanomyrma-lubei-s4.promptSummary: Green River leaf macro scene with one winged queen, six legs and four wings.

gastornis-gigantea-s4.promptSummary: High-oblique Eocene fruit-floor scene; straight toothless beak and non-predatory behavior.

titanoboa-cerrejonensis-s4.promptSummary: High-oblique Cerrejon swamp S-curve; one continuous limbless body, one head and one tail.

basilosaurus-isis-s4.promptSummary: Banking Tethys scene showing the long body, tiny hind-limb pair and horizontal fluke; far foreflipper is occluded.
